Subject: Post-demo: Pen-test handover, SOC 2 status & vuln SLA

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side after today's demo: 

Summary (2 min):
- Carelytics demo went well; team is primarily focused on PHI handling, SOC 2 evidence, and a predictable pen-test/disclosure workflow.
- You indicated SOC 2 Type II in progress (expected Q3) and a vendor security questionnaire that the security team will push to vendors.

Action items I volunteered: 
1) Share a concise list of items you'll want in a pen-test handback (report/redaction policy/POC access) — attached "carelytics-penreport-ask.xlsx" as a starting template.
2) Confirm our recommended vulnerability SLA options (propose 30/60/90 days triage windows depending on severity).
3) Start the vendor security questionnaire exchange — we can accept either completed PDFs or a SecurityScorecard/OneTrust link.

Internal ask: Marissa / Karthik, can you review the attached template and suggest any additional Redwood items (esp. around KV cache logs and token redaction language) before I send this to Alex?

Next proposed customer-facing steps (if we agree):
- I send the updated pen-report ask + proposed SLA table to Alex & Priya.
- Marissa joins an intake call next week to go over evidence packaging and sharing method (eg. S3 presigned vs. secure portal).

Attachments: carelytics-penreport-ask.xlsx

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Pen-test handover, SOC 2 status & vuln SLA

Thanks Logan — really appreciated the demo. Couple of clarifications and what we can provide: 

SOC 2 status: we completed readiness work and expect Type II report in Q3 (end of August). In the meantime we can share our control mapping and interim evidence (policy docs, recent vulnerability scan summaries).

Pen-test handback expectations:
- We need to know what will be included in full report vs. redacted summary when Redwood returns proof of remediation.
- Our legal team requires a high-level executive summary we can publish internally; sensitive PoC detail needs to be redacted.

Vendor questionnaire: Priya will coordinate the vendor security questionnaire (VSA). Priya, is it okay if I forward Redwood's questionnaire to sec-team@carelytics.com and add Redwood as the vendor?

Important: Our security ops prefers pen-test reports delivered via a secure portal or S3 presigned URLs (no email attachments). Also please enumerate the SLA categories you propose (critical/high/medium/low) and expected remediation windows.

I'll take a look at the attached template and share any gaps. If acceptable, we can target an intake call Thursday 27 May — Priya, are you available?

Best,
Alex
Director, Product Security | Carelytics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@carelytics.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Pen-test handover, SOC 2 status & vuln SLA

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick reply and for flagging the delivery preferences. Looping in Vanessa (security lead) and Karthik (product-security liaison) to confirm Redwood's standard handback process and SLA options.

A few details from Redwood's side: 
- Pen-test deliverables we typically provide to customers: 
  • Redacted technical report (vendor-facing) and an executive summary for customer internal consumption.
  • Full technical report available under NDA or via secure portal (we can whitelist your tester IP if needed).
  • Evidence of remediation: PR/issue tracker links, patch notes, and verification scans.

- Recommended SLA (we can adapt):
  • Critical (RCE, data exfil): 7 days to mitigation plan, 30 days to remediation verification.
  • High (auth bypass, sensitive data exposure): 14 days to mitigation plan, 60 days to remediation verification.
  • Medium: 30 days to mitigation plan, 90 days to remediation verification.
  • Low: product backlog prioritization, typical 180-day window.

- Scan cadence suggestions: weekly authenticated scans for high-change subsystems during onboarding ramp; otherwise bi-weekly automated scans + quarterly full authenticated scans + annual external pentest.

Notes on disclosure: 
- We support coordinated disclosure and will redact PoC details from the summary. For public-facing timelines we recommend a 30-day embargo from initial handback unless there is immediate risk.

Next steps (for this thread): 
1) Logan: please update the attached spreadsheet to include the SLA table above and add a column for preferred delivery method (portal/S3/NDAs).
2) Alex/Priya: confirm intake call time Thursday 27 May or propose alternatives.
3) Vanessa/Karthik: I will send a short doc with our evidence packaging checklist (soc2/hipaa-relevant items) after this thread.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (coming), mutual-action-plan.docx (template)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
